comments.body: This root-module edit is outside the task's Files list and is forbidden by STYLE.md. Remove the added import. The branch is also behind `origin/master`, which supplies the required staged verifier and `check-task.sh`; merge it, retaining the base version of this shared root, then run both required checks.

The C citations throughout the module need the required exact `file.c:LINE` or `file.c:FROM-TO` form and must point to the claimed operation. This one cites lines 337-347 for the length rejection, but the `curr < 1 || curr > 20` check and `BZ_DATA_ERROR` are at `decompress.c:327`. The min/max citation at line 17 likewise points to 359-364 instead of `decompress.c:339-344`. Correct all C citations, including the uncited alphabet-size and bit-writer claims, against their actual source lines.

The claim that `bsW` keeps only the low `len` bits on an over-subscribed code is false. `compress.c:73-77` ORs the unmasked value into the bit buffer, so a high bit can alter a preceding buffered bit; for example, writing code value 2 with length 1 after a zero bit can change that earlier bit. Keep `codeword` as an explicitly defined truncation if useful, but remove the claim that this is what the C encoder sends for malformed tables.
This line is 101 characters; STYLE.md limits lines to 100. Wrap it so the staged style check can pass.

last.summary: The core assignment and decode-table formulas agree with the vendored C source on the cases checked: increasing-length/index assignment (`huffman.c:152-165`), perm/base/limit construction (`huffman.c:170-200`), the 1..20 length error (`decompress.c:323-334`), the 21-bit failure and 258-entry bound (`decompress.c:88-101`), MSB-first reads (`decompress.c:43-65`), and the 258-symbol limit (`decompress.c:274-284`, `bzlib_private.h:115`). The complete, incomplete and over-subscribed examples build. The current checkout's old verifier reports `verify: ok`; its `check-task.sh` is absent, although the `origin/master` Huffman check passes when run directly with Lean. Merge current `origin/master` and run its staged verifier and named task check after the fixes below.
